listing_info.listing_name: The Dam Lake House-Relax and Enjoy the Views!
listing_info.description:
"The Dam Lake House" is a Beautiful Lakefront Home on Sunrise Lake! Enjoy the great sunsets from this property that has ~150 feet of lake front with a shallow walk in beach area. Come in summer to enjoy the swimming, the Fall to enjoy the great views of the foliage changing or come in Winter to enjoy the snowmobiling, great ice fishing or skiing at close by Gunstock Mtn (35 min). This home was designed with care and can fit many families needs or groups of friends.

The space
Our place on Sunrise Lake is set apart by being one of the more private spaces on the lake that abuts the lakes Dam. This home was finished September of 2023. The home is well appointed with everything you'd need for your stay (linens, bath towels, beach towels, etc).

Enjoy great views and experiences - whether your passion is fishing for bass on the dock, relaxing or swimming on the private beach, or roasting marshmallows at the fire pit. In the Fall enjoy the broad sweeping views this home has to offer of the foilage changing and finally in the Winter enjoy skiing nearby at Gunstock, ice fishing, or snowmobile along the nearby trails. This home truly is a year round paradise. We work really hard and take pride in our home. If you are celebrating a little occasion or here to just to relax, we like to add simple little touches to make your stay more welcoming! We enjoy spending time with our families here. We love this house and want others to enjoy it as much as we do when we are not there.

Please Note:
*Booking implies that all guests agree to follow all House Rules. Important parts of the house rules are but are not limited to - No gatherings, no large get togethers and no parties allowed; only registered guests can be there at any time.

House Rules:

There are cameras on the premises on the exterior of the home: They are located at the main entry points to the property, dock, driveway, side of the house, and the two front doors. They are used to ensure guest safety, adherence to guest policy, and reviewed as needed for any other purpose.

Trash: ALL TRASH MUST BE BAGGED. (Trash bags supplied) There are two trash barrels meant to support your trash needs during your stay. If there is loose trash in barrels the trash will NOT be picked up and will result in a fee, renter will be charged ( $100 per barrel).

Owner’s rooms/storage are locked: There are 4 interior doors that are locked. Entry into these rooms or evidence of entry will result in immediate termination of rental without refund. If entry is found after stay fines will be levied.

NO large Gatherings or Parties: ONLY registered guests are allowed on the property. This limit is strictly enforced. If the limit is exceeded all guests including the renter will be asked to vacate the property without a refund If you wish for additional registered guests to stay, this can be discussed at a potential fee per day per guest ONLY IF presented prior to your stay but will not always be approved.

No Pets: This is a pet free home to avoid damage and potential impact to future renters with allergies.

No Septic damaging products allowed: Examples are: Feminine products, or products with bleach. Wipes must go in garbage, not down the drain. There is no garbage disposal, all food and grease need to be removed to the trash. Additional fees will apply. (Starting at $400 for septic drain + treatment fees).

Abutting Dam: The Dam we abut provides a great view but is town owned. The town has asked us to inform visitors not to use the dam. The Dam is to the left of the Concrete wall next to our beach. Evidence of non-adherence can result in fines or the need to vacate the property without refund.

NO SMOKING OR VAPING ON THE PROPERTY: If the smell of smoke or vaping is within the home or any evidence of smoking or vaping or any related residue, butts, joints, etc. is found on the property you will be levied a fine starting at $1,000.

Keep Skis and Snowboards Outside: Please ensure that skis and snowboards are kept outside. Any damage cleaning fees arising from this will result in fines.

Dock Use: there is a dock on the property. There is no authorized use of the dock for docking your own personal craft. The owners crafts are docked here and will be covered. Any attempt to uncover, use, or damage the boats will result in immediate termination of the rental and dismissal from the property. Fines will also be levied for damages found as a result of these actions.

All other items: documented damage done during your stay will require cost for repair/replacement for any item.

Guest access
The entire home is being rented, however the owners bedroom(s) are locked and not included as part of the space - these spaces were not listed in the descriptions of the home so no need to be concerned - everything you saw in the listing is available for your use.

Enjoy the lake, beach, lawn, patio, decks, grill, dock and firepit.

IMPORTANT - Any power craft on dock are the owners and are not part of rental. Any attempted use will result in the immediate termination of the rental without refund. Any damage to these crafts by renters will be the responsibility of the renter to cover.

*Please note, all Kayaks/Paddleboards/swim mat, Grill and other summer items are only available from memorial day to columbus day (indiginous peoples day).

Other things to note
There is no access allowed to the Dam, or on the grass to the left of our property. The Dam provides great views but no trespassing is allowed. Details around where the specific boundaries are is included in the welcome guide.

listing_info.listing_name: Blue Breeze - Private lakefront w/ Hot Tub
listing_info.description:
This huge lakeside house is a great experience for all of your friends and family to enjoy all the New Hampshire lakes region has to offer. There is incredible nature all around!

Some of our favorites nearby:
11min to a nearby brewery
12min to a great breakfast spot
14min to a farm stand and pick-your-own produce
17min to a nearby winery
21min to Hannafords grocery store
22min to Alton Bay
25min to Wolfeboro
29min to Mt. Major with views of Winnipesaukee
38min to Gunstock mountain for skiing

The space
Whether you like to enjoy a day in the sun, or explore throughout the countryside, consider our home as a centrally located home base for all of your New Hampshire and Maine adventures. With this lakefront home, you have access to the best parts of every season - refreshing water, warm sunlight, gorgeous New England foliage, soft snow, and plenty of outdoor recreational activity!

Set upon a private, tranquil lake in the Mountains and Lakes Region of NH, we created this home to be big and bright, filled with amenities to meet all of your vacation needs! The home naturally boasts incredible views of the lake and mountain region that extend into the living room. You are fully connected to nature here - from the upstairs deck to the downstairs screened in patio, the sounds of lapping water and loon songs fill the space.

At Blue Breeze, you can truly disconnect and spend time in tranquility, enjoying the lake that’s right in your backyard. Fishing, swimming, kayaking, and boating are all welcome here! Spend time enjoying fresh food off the gas grill, soak up the sun on the private, sandy beach, and make memories with loved ones around a campfire!

Some of our great amenities:
- private dock*
- huge hot tub
- private sandy beach area
- central multi-zone A/C
- over-supplied kitchen
- fully screened in patio
- sun filled top deck
- downstairs kitchenette
- gas fire table*
- outdoor fire pit
- outdoor dining area*
- outdoor hammock and reclining lounge chairs*
- 2 kayaks, 1 canoe, and 1 paddle boat, with life vests and paddles provided
- fish for bass, perch, and pickerel (bring your own gear!)*
- the 2nd best stargazing in New Hampshire!
- ample parking, including room for trailers
- boat ramp up the road
- sleeper sofa for an extra guest
- plenty of bedrooms and sleeping space for everyone!
-3200 Sq ft.


Some important notes:
- We provide kayaks, canoes, and a paddleboat when the seasons allow it - as soon as the lake is navigable. Grills are Summer only. Other items starred (*) above are Summer season only and may not be available in the Winter.
- Sunrise Lake is boat friendly and there is a boat launch up the road. We do not provide any motorized recreational water equipment. Please use the boat ramp up the road for launching any motorized equipment!
- Swimming is so nice here - and the lake is rather shallow, so it's easy to enjoy the entirety of it. We recommend bringing some water shoes if a rocky / leafy lake bottom bothers you at all. You can easily get to a sand bar by kayak or swim right in front of the house that has a nice large sandy bottom to it.

Guest access
You will have access to your own dock, sandy beach, a shed that has some outdoor gear, a beautiful 4 bedroom house, and the outdoor space up to the planted tree lines.

Parking is available near the shed on the property.

We are a quick 20 minute drive to Rochester, which has plenty of shopping, grocery stores, pharmacies, and food & beverage options. For those traveling from out of town, we are a 1 hour drive from the Manchester and Portland airports, and a 90 minute drive from Boston Logan airport.

Other things to note
Please note any water inherently comes with some risk, including but not limited to injury or drowning, so please supervise children and exercise caution at all times. Swim at your own risk.

We are fully emersed in nature, and we do bug control on the property, but please note that there may be spiders, mosquitos, or other insects! While the lake is usually beautiful and perfectly swimmable, please be aware that it is a natural body of water and is subject to natural events like algae blooms and others, which may affect swimability.

**Pet Policy**

Pets are allowed only with prior approval. Before booking, please let us know the type, breed, age, weight, and number of pets you plan to bring.

This home allows a maximum of one dog under 50 lbs with non-refundable pet fee. Cats are not permitted.

Bringing an undisclosed or unapproved pet may result in additional fees, cancellation of the reservation where permitted by Airbnb's policies, or denial of check-in.

Escape to this cozy lakeside retreat with direct access to Crescent Lake - perfect for swimming, kayaking, or simply enjoying the view. Bring your own boat and take advantage of the private dock, offering effortless access to the water for fishing, cruising, or sunset rides. In the evening, gather around the fire pit and unwind under the stars.​

This house is ideal for couples, families, or groups seeking comfort, nature, and connection.

The space
Welcome to your perfect getaway in Wolfeboro, NH. This spacious 5-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers a comfortable and inviting space for families or groups seeking both relaxation and adventure.

This house offers direct access to Crescent Lake, providing opportunities for boating, fishing, and swimming. Additionally, Crescent Lake connects to Lake Wentworth, allowing for extended water-based activities.

Just a short distance away to Lake Winnipesaukee for swimming, boating, and fishing on New Hampshire’s largest lake. Discover local history at the Wright Museum of World War II and the New Hampshire Boat Museum, enjoy a scenic stroll or bike ride along the Cotton Valley Rail Trail, take in the breathtaking views at Castle in the Clouds, and experience the charm of Downtown Wolfeboro with its unique shops, cafés, and galleries.

After a day of exploring, return to your comfortable retreat to relax and share stories of your adventures. Whether you're seeking outdoor excitement or a peaceful escape, this home serves as the perfect base for your Wolfeboro experience.

Guests are welcome to bring their boat and dock it at our private pier. Enjoy easy access to the water for boating, waterskiing, and more right from the property!!

listing_info.listing_name: Lakefront Home Recently Built - Prime Spot
listing_info.description:
Just 5 minutes from downtown Wolfeboro, NH, this beautifully newly built waterfront retreat is designed for comfort and connection. With 2 spacious living rooms, 2 fully equipped kitchens, 4 bathrooms, and 10 beds, it’s perfect for families or large groups. Enjoy a private dock, expansive deck with scenic views, sandy beach, fire pit, and a fun tire swing—plus complimentary kayaks and paddleboards for unforgettable days on the water.

The space
Property Layout

Welcome in—this newly constructed home is thoughtfully spread across three levels for both comfort and convenience. The main level, where you enter from the street, makes arrivals easy and seamless. Head downstairs to the walk-out lower level, where you’ll find direct access to the beach, dock, and lake—perfect for stepping right into your waterfront experience. Upstairs, the upper level offers beautiful views of the property and an open overlook into the main living area below.

A Quick Note

As a brand-new home, we’re still putting the finishing touches in place. You may notice a few minor details like paint touch-ups being completed, but everything is fully functional and ready for you to enjoy your stay.

Guest access
Enjoy full access to the entire property and private waterfront during your stay. The 30ft dock is perfect for relaxing, swimming, or launching a day on the lake. While we do not provide a motorized boat, guests are welcome to bring their own or rent one locally—there will be dedicated space available along the dock for your convenience.

listing_info.listing_name: Stunning Lakefront Oasis—Hot Tub, Beach & Luxury!
listing_info.description:

Adventure awaits with kayaks, paddleboards, and endless lake fun. Indoors, gather around cozy fireplaces or fire pits, spacious living areas, and exciting family games. Perfect for unforgettable memories with loved ones and pets!

The space
Tucked away on a quiet shore of Belleau Lake, this stunning 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom East Wakefield home boasts 102’ of private waterfront, multiple decks overlooking the lake, and plenty of private sleeping arrangements—ideal for a peaceful getaway with all your loved ones. By day, enjoy swimming, kayaking, and games on the private sandy beach. Conclude each evening with s'mores by the fire, a board game around the dining room table, or a soak in the hot tub while the sun dips across the lake!

🏡 The Property:

📐 1,872 Sq Ft
🌊 Lakefront Location
🧺 Laundry Machines
🛶 Kayaks & Paddle Boards
🐾 Pet Friendly with Fee

🧰Remodeled interior, high ceilings, natural light, exposed beams, flat-screen Smart TVs in both living rooms, Smart TVs in all four bedrooms, Roku, fireplace and wood stove, formal dining table, game room with foosball table, pinball machine, Infinity Game Table, and board games.

📌 Other Things to Note:
✔️ Check-in: 4 PM
✔️ Check-out: 10 AM
🚫 No smoking
🐶 Pet friendly with $75 fee per pet (plus fees & taxes, 2 pet maximum)
❌ No events, parties, or large gatherings. Guests must respect quiet hours and lake neighbors.
📌 Must be at least 25 years old to book
💲 Additional fees and taxes may apply

📋 Rental Agreement must be signed by all guests before arrival

🔇 Noise Policy: Minut noise detectors are installed inside and outside the property. If noise levels exceed 80 decibels for more than 10 minutes, guests will be in violation of house rules and may be asked to vacate the property.
📹 Security Measures: Ring doorbell security cameras monitor the front entrances, driveway, back deck, and lakefront—strictly outdoor coverage only to protect your privacy.

Guest access
Guests enjoy full access to the house, decks, hot tub, beach, lake gear, driveway, and all listed amenities. The private boat launch is not accessible.

Other things to note
✅ This property has special local compliance requirements which include a signed rental agreement, ID verification, and a security hold of $1000 (which is not a traditional security deposit, just a pending transaction). As an optional alternative to the security hold, you may opt in to purchase a non-refundable damage waiver provided by a third-party insurance company. The optional damage waiver is $49 for stays up to 10 nights, with an additional $5 per day for stays longer than 10 nights. Damage waiver purchases are optional.

Pet Fee - $75

Open concept main floor
3 levels (3100 sq ft) for privacy
Family & dog friendly
Hot tub, kayaks, beach, game room, firepit & more!
Ideal for large families wanting to share a vacation without compromising on privacy. Enjoy year-round activities and create lasting memories. Get 10% OFF for weekly or longer stays!

Spacious Lakeside Retreat with Panoramic Views and Private Beach

10% OFF WEEKLY 7 NIGHTS OR MORE STAYS!

listing_info.listing_name: Lake Front Log Cabin · Hot Tub · Arcade · Fire Pit
listing_info.description:
Escape to a warm, spacious lakefront log cabin designed for real family time. Tucked into a quiet cove on Balch Lake, this 4BR retreat features a private sandy beach, hot tub, fireplace, heated game room, and a massive screened-in porch. With plenty of space to relax, play, and reconnect, most winter and spring guests happily stay in and make the cabin the destination.

The space
🛏️ The Space
Welcome to your warm, spacious log cabin hideaway—tucked into a peaceful cove on Balch Lake and designed for families who want to slow down, spread out, and truly enjoy time together. With multiple gathering spaces, thoughtful details throughout, and year-round comfort, this home feels just as special in winter and spring as it does in summer.

Whether you're planning a family trip, a group getaway, or a romantic retreat, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath lakefront home is packed with thoughtful touches, unique charm, and amenities designed to help you relax, recharge, and reconnect.

🛌 Sleeping Arrangements
Bedroom 1 – King Suite with Private Balcony
Located upstairs, this serene master retreat features a king bed, a private balcony overlooking the lake and fire pit, and an en suite bathroom with a tub and shower. A Roku Smart TV is available for late-night movies, and yes—the toilet paper holder is unforgettable (you’ll see!).

Bedroom 2 – Queen Bedroom with Lake Views
Located on the main floor, this bright and spacious queen bedroom overlooks the deck, screened-in porch, and lake. It's close to the kitchen and has convenient access to both a half-bath and a full shared bathroom.

Bedroom 3 – Bunk Room with 4 Twin Beds
Located on the second floor, this room is perfect for kids or friends. Featuring two sets of twin bunk beds and a Roku Smart TV, it’s the ideal hangout after a long day on the lake. Easy access to the hallway half-bath downstairs.

Bedroom 4 – Queen Bedroom with Smart TV
Also upstairs, this peaceful queen room offers comfort and privacy with a Roku Smart TV. It’s just steps from the upstairs hallway and a short walk to the half-bath downstairs.

🛶 Outdoor Highlights
Soak in the peace and privacy of your own secluded cove with 100 feet of private shoreline. Paddle out using the free kayaks and paddleboards, or enjoy the private sandy beach, large dock, and lake floats. After sunset, sink into the hot tub, roast s’mores at the fire pit, or sip wine on the screened-in porch surrounded by the sounds of nature and falling leaves.

Swimming is seasonal, but the shallow sandy beach is perfect for kids to wade and play, and many guests paddle just outside the cove for clearer water when swimming.

🔥 Indoor Comfort
Inside, tall vaulted ceilings and sunlight fill the home with a warm, inviting glow. Hand-carved beams by a local artist and exotic wood finishes give this cabin its unforgettable charm. A cozy indoor fireplace, Smart TVs, and a fully-stocked game room featuring ping pong, foosball, pinball, an NBA Jamz arcade machine, and classic board games make this a four-season retreat.

🍽️ Fully Equipped Kitchen
The open-concept kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a gas range stove, ample counter space, and everything you need to cook a big family meal or keep things simple. The breakfast bar is perfect for morning coffee or post-hike snacks.

🌲 A Unique, Private Experience
Balch Lake is a rare gem—peaceful, quiet, and perfect for those seeking a true escape. With minimal pass-through boat traffic in the cove, you’ll enjoy a quieter, more peaceful stretch of the lake. Whether you’re swimming, paddling, or fishing off the dock, it’s all yours.

📋 House Rules

✔️ Check-in: 4 PM
✔️ Check-out: 10 AM
🙊 Quiet Hours 10pm-8am: This is a peaceful retreat meant for those who appreciate nature and quiet relaxation—please respect our quiet hours and our neighbors.
🚫 No smoking
🐶 Pet friendly with a $75 per pet fee (2 max)
❌ No events, parties, or large gatherings

listing_info.listing_name: Lake Winnipesaukee/9min to Gunstock Mtn. Alton Bay
listing_info.description:
Family lake house built over the water on Lake Winnipesaukee. Great place for families and children. Only 9 min. to Gunstock Mountain for exceptional NH skiing. Close to many amazing hikes and set in the middle of world class foliage! Quiet, serene, and restful cottage that offers something for everyone. Whether is swimming, paddle boarding, and hiking in the summer or skiing, ice fishing and relaxing by the wood stove in the winter, this cottage will relax and revive you and your loved ones.

The space
Guest have access to the entire house, docks, and decks. The attic is locked and portions of the garage are locked. If it’s not locked guests have access to it.

Other things to note
Guest will need to stay on our property which is clearly defined.

The house has many steps, many are inconsistent in tread size and riser length making it potentially hazardous to walk up or down. Guests accept the risk of renting an older cottage.

Lake Winnipesaukee Waterfront with dock, great views, centrally located on the "quiet" side of the lake. This 4 bedroom 3.5 bath custom-built home has three levels of living space with lake views. Enjoy walking trails, direct lake access, hot tub(up to 6), 8 kayaks, fishing, etc. owner on property in separate building. Shared dock. No pets. Inquire with questions.

The space
Perfect home for large groups- up to 12(families/friends vacationing together.)

Guest access
Guests have the entire lake house to themselves, the owner/caretaker occasionally stays in the apartment across the driveway, and the dock is shared with the owner if and when she is there.

Other things to note
No pets of any kind allowed.
Owner has contact info for a boat charter that can pick up and drop off passengers at the dock. Info will be left at the house.
Host has amenities menu that includes on site therapeutic massage therapist, meditation, Reiki, on site Chef for meal(s) and or cooking class, yoga, and more. Contact host with questions.
Please contact host if you would like an extended vacation stay, dates flexible.
